scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for index-two tails and two-ray vector measure; numerical checker only corroborates finite cases. No independent audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed sample size n>=2; the threshold alone goes to infinity.
Independent area-uniform two-sphere observations with deterministic a in [-1,1]; no estimated parameters, adaptive tuning or other dimensions.
No finite-threshold relative-error bounds, statistical power claims or growing-n uniform approximation.
Historical priority is assessed through specific sources and searches, not independently certified.
title: Two-ray extreme-tail law for a stereographic spherical uniformity statistic
